subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed SKILL.md diagnostics be accepted first as a new skills lint command, or must normal skills list/check/gateway/Web status also surface skipped-candidate failures before this issue is considered fixed?
rationale: Current main still lacks diagnostics, and the open implementation candidate leaves a product-scope choice about the public diagnostic surface and redaction boundary.

options.title: Land lint first
options.body: Use the open PR as the first repair after its review blocker is fixed, and track broader status/Web visibility separately if maintainers still want it.

options.title: Require full visibility
options.body: Keep the issue open until skipped SKILL.md failures are exposed through normal CLI status and Web surfaces, not only through a separate lint command.

options.title: Narrow to documentation
options.body: Treat runtime behavior as acceptable and update authoring docs only, leaving validation to external skill tooling.

recommendation.title: Land lint first
recommendation.body: Use the open PR as the first repair after its review blocker is fixed, and track broader status/Web visibility separately if maintainers still want it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across the skills CLI/parser surface and related maintainer triage comments.
